card.name: Photoshop tutorial tool and setting names
card.fires_on: Words inside Photoshop or graphics-editor instructions, such as blend mode names, tool options, layer types and settings, just before a value or option is given.

modes.label: Blend mode names
modes.description: The bracket or word ending the Linear Dodge blend mode name in layer instructions.
modes.example: choose Blend Mode: Linear Dodge<< (>>Add). Press Cmd/Ctrl+G

modes.label: Tool option labels
modes.description: Option words like shape, control, dynamics or Radius in tool settings, before a value.
modes.example: Select pen tool with brush set to 3px and shape<< dynamics>>:- control set to Fade.

modes.label: Software version or spacing
modes.description: Spots in software or measurement text such as the CS version name or the space before a number.
modes.example: only available in Photoshop<< CS>>, and above
